title: Prayer After Ziyarat Waritha
intro: The supplication following Ziyarat Waritha in the selected source edition, presented separately from the main visitation.
description: Read Prayer After Ziyarat Waritha with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.transliteration: allahumma inni sallaytu wa raka`tu wa sajadtu
blocks.english: O Allah, I have offered a prayer, genuflected, and prostrated myself
for Your sake purely without setting any partner with You
since all prayers, genuflection, and prostration

blocks.arabic: لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
blocks.transliteration: li'annaka anta allahu la ilaha illa anta
blocks.english: Because You are Allah, there in n0 god save You.

blocks.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
blocks.transliteration: allahumma salli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin
blocks.english: O Allah, (please) send blessings on Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
and convey to them my best greetings and compliments
and convey to me their replies.
O Allah, these two units of prayer
are present from me to my master
al-Husayn the son of `Ali, peace be upon both of them.
O Allah, send blessings on Muhammad and on him,
accept my effort, and reward me for it
in the best rewarding that I anticipate and hope from You

blocks.transliteration: wa fi waliyyika ya waliyya almu'minina
blocks.english: and from Your saint, O Guardian of the faithful!

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ دعا بعد زیارت وارثہ کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
